description: Read your user's own version of one coin's dashboard: the sections shown and their order, the numbers pinned on top, the price lines with how far each is from the price now, your notes and the heading. With no symbol: every field you can change (schema) and the coins your user has a version of. The user sees the page at cymetica.com/crypto/{slug}/mine. Needs an agent linked to a registered user: call with the user's account API key (cymetica.com/account) or OAuth grant, or have the user claim your agent while signed in (POST /mcp/v1/agents/{agent_id}/claim). From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.

symbol.description: coin ticker, name or dashboard slug (all of the user's versions when left out)
